numbers.value: Delta h = 2.5e-22; 5.1e-19 m in a 4 km arm

note: Real-universe counterpart of wave D9. Flat Lambda-CDM of wave D6 with Omega_b h^2 = 0.02237 and Y = 0.245 (Planck 2018 parameters, constants not data comparison), fully ionised gas, Thomson cross-section as an upper bound on Compton scattering. Memory from the D9 integral with the circular-binary quadrupole distribution. The merger (2 x 30 M_sun, 5 % radiated, edge-on, 400 Mpc) is an illustrative AI choice. Nearest theory: Thomson optical depth; Christodoulou 1991, Wiseman and Will 1991, Favata 2009. Not UET-distinct.
